description: NHFLOW semi-implicit step with the non-hydrostatic pressure (A 510 12, A 520 2) in 2D: sloshing mode (1,1) of a closed 1 m x 1 m basin, kh = 2, 16 x 16 columns, 3 sigma layers, dt = T/40. The coupled eta-phi system is solved by FGMRES with the column-relaxation multigrid (K-cycle) of nhflow_si_nhmg; period error 3.6e-3 against linear theory.
covers: nhflow_si_nhmg: block red-black Gauss-Seidel, aggregation, K-cycle
